component.name: Slate
component.summary: Text and code editor with graphical and terminal interfaces

description.p: Slate edits text and code in a desktop window or a terminal. Both interfaces share one editor core: documents, undo history, split panes, terminals, Git and workspace recovery behave the same in each.

ul.li: A nano-compatible terminal interface that runs without a desktop
Encodings, line endings, file watching and metadata-preserving saves
Syntax highlighting, minimap, soft wrap and printing
Integrated terminals and a Git changes view
